why: Phase 3's real test, and the expensive one. The seven cards of packs/cost-lettered.json all carry four ordinary pips or fewer, which is exactly the population the model already took 18 of 18 of — passing there would prove nothing about the gate. These four are the four it has ever missed, from EXPERIMENT-lettered-25-2026-08-19: Progenitus ten pips painted as nine, Niv-Mizzet six painted as five, Kitchen Finks hybrid split into two pips, Birthing Pod Phyrexian drawn as plain green. Terror of the Peaks is the in-population control. Two things have to be true of the result, and the second matters more than the first: (1) check.proofread raises cost_wrong on every card whose cost came back wrong — a silent pass here means the gate does not work and cost_lettered must stay off; (2) every card in this folder ships with EXACTLY ONE cost on it and that cost is right, via the escalation repaint. A card with two costs, or one wrong cost, is a Phase 3 NO-GO. Style and archetype are held at the cost-lettered batch's values so cost complexity is the only variable; these are not the styles the 2026-08-19 signoff used.
